baselineDateRange.description: An explicit baseline window. Overrides query.compare.

date_to.description: Same format. Omit or null for "now".

query.description: The service health query. Every field is optional.

compare.description:
The baseline. previous_period (default) is the same length just before the window. previous_day and previous_week shift the window back 1 or 7 days. none skips it. baselineDateRange overrides it.

* `none` - None
* `previous_period` - Previous Period
* `previous_day` - Previous Day
* `previous_week` - Previous Week

dateRange.description: The window to score. Defaults to the last hour.

date_to.description: Same format. Omit or null for "now".

environment.description: Only this environment, matched without case on deployment.environment.name, then deployment.environment, then env.

orderBy.description:
status (default) puts silent, regressed and degraded first. The others sort high to low.

* `status` - Status
* `error_rate` - Error Rate
* `p95` - P95
* `throughput` - Throughput
* `error_count` - Error Count

spanScope.description:
entry (default) counts root, server and consumer spans, one per request. all counts every span.

* `entry` - Entry
* `all` - All
